title: Same passage: identify
text: The school playground was empty after the rain. Puddles shone on the ground, and the climbing frame dripped with water. Sam stood by the gate, holding a torn football, while dark clouds gathered again above the school.
question: Identify one object Sam is holding.
weakExplanation: This finds a detail, but it does not answer what Sam is holding.
exceptionalAnswer: Sam is holding a torn football.

title: Same passage: describe
text: The school playground was empty after the rain. Puddles shone on the ground, and the climbing frame dripped with water. Sam stood by the gate, holding a torn football, while dark clouds gathered again above the school.

weakExplanation: This is true, but it does not describe what the playground is like.

title: Same passage: explain
text: The school playground was empty after the rain. Puddles shone on the ground, and the climbing frame dripped with water. Sam stood by the gate, holding a torn football, while dark clouds gathered again above the school.
question: Explain why the playground might be empty.
weakExplanation: This repeats the question but does not give a reason.
exceptionalAnswer: The playground might be empty because it has been raining, so the children may have gone inside to stay dry. The dark clouds also suggest that more rain may be coming, which would make people less likely to play outside.
